name: Bolster
body:
Your channeled energy boosts the bravery of your allies.

Prerequisite: Channel energy

Benefit: Any creature healed by a use of your channel energy ability gains a +1 luck bonus on attack and damage rolls, as well as a resistance bonus to saves against fear equal to your Wisdom bonus (minimum +1). These bonuses last for one round for each die of healing dealt by your channel energy.
